article.body_preview:
Bangladesh and the International Monetary Fund (IMF) have reached a staff-level agreement that would see the country receive a total $4.5 billion in loan support amid global economic uncertainty due to the Russia-Ukraine war.

The 42-month agreement says that funds will be divided between the Extended Credit Facility (ECF), the Extended Fund Facility (EFF), and the Resilience and Sustainability Facility.
